paragraphs.text: Live hardware and token telemetry for DeepSeek Harness: GPU and CPU load, VRAM, temperature, power,
energy, generation speed and context fill of the current session.
English | Русский
PriRex Monitor
GPU · CPU · VRAM · power · energy · token speed · context fill — live telemetry for DeepSeek Harness
AM · power · energy · token speed · context fill — live telemetry for DeepSeek Harness, on one page.
The page: hardware cards, context ring and the last requests. Hardware numbers are read from the mac
hine; the token rows come from a demo session.
## English
### Overview

PriRex Monitor adds a **Monitor** entry to the DSH sidebar plus a full telemetry page in the main
pa

nel. The host half samples the machine on a fixed interval, accumulates token usage from the
session

event stream, and publishes the snapshot two ways: a JSON route and an SSE stream that keeps
the pa
ge live without polling.
| Half | File | Role |

| Host | `index.js` | samples sensors, accumulates token usage, serves two local routes |
| Browser
| `client.js` (built from `client.template.js`) | sidebar entry + page, `React.createElement` only,
styled with host theme tokens |
### What the page shows
| Card | Content |

| Speed | tokens/s of the session; `0 tok/s` means the model is idle |
| GPU load | utilization %, w

ith a 40-point sparkline |
| VRAM | used / total GB |
| GPU temperature | °C — the sparkline turns w

arning-colored above the configured threshold |
| Power | draw / limit, W |
| PCIe | link generation

and width (`Gen4 x16`) |
| CPU | total load % |
| Disk | read throughput (B/s) where the platform r
eports it; on Windows, which has no byte-rate provider, it shows free space of the system volume |
Below the cards: **energy since host start** (Wh, integrated from GPU power draw), **GPU fan** (%),
**GPU clock** (MHz), a **context fill** ring (used / window tokens) and a **recent requests** table

—
time, status, model, input tokens, cache-read tokens, output tokens, cache share.

GPU numbers come from `nvidia-smi`, because `systeminformation` does not expose utilization, fan
spe

ed or PCIe link width on Windows. Without an NVIDIA tool the module falls back to
`systeminformation
`, so AMD/Intel machines still get load, temperature, power and VRAM.
### Why PriRex Monitor
- **Real sensors, not guesses** — `nvidia-smi` reports what the driver knows: utilization, VRAM, fan

,
power draw against the limit, temperature, SM clock and the PCIe link; every other platform falls

back to `systeminformation` instead of showing nothing.
- **One page instead of three tools** — hard

ware, the context window and the cost of the current
session sit together, so a slow answer can be e

xplained without leaving the chat.
- **Live, not polled** — samples arrive over SSE every 500 ms; th

e page falls back to a 2 s poll only
if the stream is unavailable.
- **Zero setup** — no config file

to write, no build during installation (`client.js` is committed),
no service to run; the plugin sa

mples the machine it is already installed on.
- **Local by design** — two same-origin `GET` routes,

no outbound traffic, no filesystem access, and
a `nvidia-smi` call with a fixed argument vector.
- *

*Fits the host** — colors come from DSH theme tokens, so the page matches light and dark themes
with
out a second stylesheet.
### Installation
Requirements: DeepSeek Harness with the Web surface, Node.js ≥ 20.

**From GitHub** — *Plugins → Install bundle → GitHub* and use the repository name
`Prirex/PriRex-Mon

itoring-DeepSeek-Harness`. `client.js` is committed, so nothing is built during
installation.

**From a local folder** — *Plugins → Install bundle → local path* and point it at this folder. DSH
l
inks it with a directory junction at `node_modules/prirex-monitoring-deepseek-harness`.
> These two routes must not occupy the same slot at once. If a local link is still in place and you

> then install the GitHub version, pnpm cannot replace the junction and fails with
> `[ERR_PNPM_EPER

M] importPackage`. Close DSH and drop the link first — only the junction is
> removed, the project f

older stays intact:
>

### HTTP routes
Registered on the DSH web server, both local-only by design:
| Route | Format | Notes |

| `/api/prirex-monitor/telemetry` | JSON snapshot | `GET` / `HEAD` only |
| `/api/prirex-monitor/str
eam` | SSE | pushes every fresh sample, `retry: 2000` hint |
The client consumes the stream and falls back to polling the JSON route every 2 s when the stream is

nsumes the stream and falls back to polling the JSON route every 2 s when the stream is
unavailable.
### Security

- `GET`/`HEAD` only (`405` otherwise); `Origin` must match `Host`; `Sec-Fetch-Site: cross-site` is
r

ejected — all `403`.
- No outbound network traffic, no filesystem access, no shell: `nvidia-smi` is

spawned with a fixed
argument vector.
- Telemetry updates are wrapped so a failure can never disturb

xed
argument vector.
- Telemetry updates are wrapped so a failure can never disturb session commits.
Details and the reporting process: `SECURITY.md`.
